verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://docs.granola.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the docs and help center. The docs themselves are served as per-page .md files, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable markdown. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
